CustomField.description: The shared meter being split. FSD 5.10.3 makes allocation a child of Meter, and says allocations exist only where one meter serves several spaces. Master detail so the meter can roll up its total allocated percentage.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The meter whose consumption is being divided. Allocations are only needed where one meter serves more than one space; a meter serving a single space needs none at all.
CustomField.label: Meter
